sn24.2:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.3: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || || 3
sn24.2:1.5: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.6: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || || 5-7
sn24.2:1.10: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.2:1.11: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || || 9
sn24.2:2.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn24.2:2.9: Api nu tam upādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.2:2.10: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn24.2:2.12: Yam pidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutam mutam viññātam pattam pariyesitam anuvicaritam manasā tam pi niccaṃ va aniccaṃ vā ti ||
sn24.2:2.14: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukkhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn24.2:2.16: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.2:2.17: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn24.2:3.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti || dukkhe pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti || la || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti ||
sn24.2:3.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 1-2
